title: Kundalini Potion Vortex
description: A witch in a dark blue robe stands in an apothecary, hands raised as she conjures a massive swirling vortex of green, red, and orange magical energy. A glowing potion jar labeled 'Kundalini Potion of Transformation' floats within the spiral above an open scroll covered in red and green serpentine symbols.
prompt: A dramatic fantasy scene inside a gothic apothecary at night with lightning visible through arched windows. A female witch in a dark blue robe stands at a wooden table covered with an open scroll showing red and green serpents. She raises her hands to conjure a massive swirling vortex of green, red, and orange smoke and energy. A glowing glass potion bottle labeled 'Kundalini Potion of Transformation' floats in the center of the spiral. Shelves filled with jars, dried lavender, and a hanging lantern are visible. Dramatic lighting, vibrant colors, detailed fantasy illustration.
